authorization.interpreted_scope: Authorize the controller to start further isolated blind evaluations and make orchestration decisions. This does not convert controller-authored modeling choices into human choices and does not authorize formal release integration without a new exact-hash approval.

ordered_blocks.purpose: Test the R2 workflow on an untouched, structurally different official problem before seeing any comparison material.
ordered_blocks.stop_rule: Freeze the blind output before any external comparison. Stop at a genuinely human-owned method or claim decision unless the user supplies that exact decision.

ordered_blocks.purpose: Separate task-specific difficulty from a reproducible Skill contract failure; reject cosmetic or one-off changes.
Implement at most two compact change bundles supported by blind evidence, with observable behavior tests.
Retest on an independent untouched problem, audit the candidate, and stop at a new exact-hash formal-integration gate.

all_required: The failure changes a modeling decision or makes a legal output impossible, misleading, or unreproducible.
The failure is attributable to a missing or defective reusable Skill contract rather than merely to the problem being difficult.
A prospective behavior test can distinguish the corrected behavior from the current release.
The correction contains no answer-specific number, method mandate, or post-hoc threshold.
change_acceptance_rule.no_gap_outcome: If no generalizable blocking gap is found, record NO_CHANGE and proceed to the next untouched blind test.

efficiency_metrics.objective: Increase real-task coverage while reducing avoidable gates, repeated executions, and evidence duplication without weakening holdout or reproducibility boundaries.

non_negotiable_boundaries: Only the exact official inputs named by a blind-test manifest may be read before its output freeze.
No answer, commentary, prior solution, development synthesis, or earlier blind-test conclusion enters the isolated executor context.
Controller decisions are labelled as controller decisions and never rewritten as human method or claim choices.
Formal target integration remains gated by release id plus exact release-manifest, full-diff, and integration-plan hashes.
Stop immediately when the iteration reaches its gate or when evidence supports NO_CHANGE.
